Night crew overtime, August

Week 1: two shifts, four crew, 31 hours
Week 2: two shifts, four crew, 30 hours
Week 3: two shifts, three crew, 24 hours
Week 4: two shifts, four crew, 32 hours

Charged to the harbour maintenance code, as in July. Sandwiches for the crew come from the
Pennet Landing canteen and are billed weekly.
